name: airo-doffy-dp-beaver-enc-c6
description: Parallel structured Beaver dp_beaver_enc training with W&B and HF upload

command: set -Eeuo pipefail; stage_dir=/tmp/airo_structured_beaver_stage; ready_file=${stage_dir}/READY; for stage_attempt in $(seq 1 900); do if [ -f "${ready_file}" ]; then exec bash "${stage_dir}/run-structured-beaver-single.sh"; fi; sleep 2; done; echo 'Timed out waiting for staged inputs' >&2; exit 2
